ValidationRule.description: An active Level 2 or 3 technical credential on the approval date, or the PSA standing in during the beta (decisions 53, 91).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: IF(PSA_Stand_In__c, OR(ISBLANK(Approved_On__c), Approved_On__c >= DATE(2027,4,1)), OR(ISBLANK(L2_Credential__c), NOT(OR(ISPICKVAL(L2_Credential__r.Step__c,"Level 2"), ISPICKVAL(L2_Credential__r.Step__c,"Level 3"))), NOT(ISPICKVAL(L2_Credential__r.Track__c,"Technical")), L2_Credential__r.Issued_On__c > Approved_On__c, L2_Credential__r.Expires_On__c <= Approved_On__c))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Needs an active Level 2 or 3 technical credential on the approval date. Only beta packages (before Apr 1, 2027) can use the PSA stand-in.
